    <!-- LOCATION GEOFENCE MODAL -->
    <div id="locationModal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 hidden items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
        <div class="bg-white p-5 rounded-3xl max-w-sm w-full shadow-2xl space-y-3 text-xs">
            <h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-caseBlue">Set Target Location & Geofence</h3>
            <div>
                <label class="block font-semibold mb-1">Target City / Jurisdiction</label>
                <input type="text" id="geoCity" value="Delhi NCR" class="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl">
            </div>
            <div>
                <label class="block font-semibold mb-1">Radius (km)</label>
                <input type="number" id="geoRadiusInput" value="25" class="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl">
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
                <button onclick="toggleModal('locationModal', false)" class="px-3 py-1.5 border rounded-xl font-bold">Cancel</button>
                <button onclick="saveLocation()" class="px-4 py-1.5 bg-caseBlue text-white font-bold rounded-xl">Apply</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- APPLICATION JAVASCRIPT ENGINE -->
    <script>
        // Pre-loaded Categories
        let categories = ["All", "Urgent Bail", "Property Diligence", "Drafting & Notices", "Corporate & Tax", "Family Court"];

        // Initial Marketplace Service Posts
        let listings = [
            {
                id: 101,
                advocate: "Adv. Rajesh Kumar",
                barId: "D/1842/2012",
                avatar: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560250097-0b93528c311a?auto=format&fit=crop&w=150&q=80",
                verified: true,
                caption: "⚡ Emergency Criminal Representation & Immediate Bail Application drafting at Saket, Patiala House & Rohini Courts. Doorstep or Police Station visit within 45 mins.",
                category: "Urgent Bail",
                price: 3500,
                location: "Delhi NCR",
                distance: 4,
                delivery: "Doorstep / On-Site Visit",
                duration: "24 Hours (Urgent)",
                imageUrl: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1589829545856-d10d557cf95f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80",
                altText: "Scales of justice sitting on legal case law books in office",
                podcastUrl: "https://open.spotify.com/episode/example1",
                rating: 4.9,
                badges: ["Bar Verified", "Rapid Responder", "Doorstep Available"],
                reviews: [
                    { author: "Suresh P.", text: "Reached Saket court fast and got the interim bail petition filed." }
                ]
            },
            {
                id: 102,
                advocate: "Adv. Rajesh Kumar",
                barId: "D/1842/2012",
                avatar: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560250097-0b93528c311a?auto=format&fit=crop&w=150&q=80",
                verified: true,
                caption: "Full 30-Year Property Legal Title Verification & Encumbrance Certificate Search. Includes physical chamber consultation and signed search report.",
                category: "Property Diligence",
                price: 6000,
                location: "Delhi NCR",
                distance: 12,
                delivery: "Chambers Visit",
                duration: "Permanent",
                imageUrl: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560518883-ce09059eeffa?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80",
                altText: "Property architectural drawings with legal agreement contracts",
                podcastUrl: null,
                rating: 4.8,
                badges: ["Bar Verified", "Top Rated"],
                reviews: [
                    { author: "Priya Sharma", text: "Very clear title search report. Saved us from a risky property investment." }
                ]
            }
        ];

        let activeCategory = "All";

        // Initialize Category Controls
        function initCategoryControls() {
            const container = document.getElementById('categoryChips');
            const selectEl = document.getElementById('postCategory');
            
            container.innerHTML = '';
            selectEl.innerHTML = '';

            categories.forEach(cat => {
                // Render filter chips
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.onclick = () => selectCategory(cat);
                btn.className = `px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition ${
                    cat === activeCategory ? 'bg-caseBlue text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                }`;
                btn.innerText = cat === 'All' ? '🌐 All Services' : cat;
                container.appendChild(btn);

                // Populate post composer dropdown
                if (cat !== 'All') {
                    const opt = document.createElement('option');
                    opt.value = cat;
                    opt.innerText = cat;
                    selectEl.appendChild(opt);
                }
            });

            // Add Custom Filter Option
            const customOpt = document.createElement('option');
            customOpt.value = "ADD_CUSTOM";
            customOpt.innerText = "+ Create Custom Category Filter...";
            selectEl.appendChild(customOpt);
        }

        // Render Marketplace Listings into 2-Column Grid
        function renderListings(data) {
            const grid = document.getElementById('listingsGrid');
            grid.innerHTML = '';

            if (data.length === 0) {
                grid.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="col-span-full bg-white p-10 text-center rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 text-slate-400">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-scale-unbalanced text-3xl mb-2"></i>
                        <p class="text-xs font-semibold">No legal listings match your active filters or radius.</p>
                    </div>`;
                return;
            }

            data.forEach(item => {
                const card = document.createElement('article');
                card.className = "bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between";
                
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div>
                        <!-- Card Header -->
                        <div class="p-4 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <img src="${item.avatar}" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover border" alt="${item.advocate}">
                                <div>
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
                                        <h2 class="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900">${item.advocate}</h2>
                                        ${item.verified ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-blue-500 text-[11px]"></i>' : ''}
                                    </div>
                                    <p class="text-[10px] text-slate-400">${item.barId} • <span class="text-slate-600 font-medium">${item.location} (${item.distance} km away)</span></p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <span class="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full font-black bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200">
                                ₹${item.price}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Tweet Caption Content -->
                        <div class="p-4 space-y-3 text-xs">
                            <p class="text-slate-800 leading-relaxed font-normal">${item.caption}</p>

                            <!-- Spec Badges -->
                            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 text-[10px]">
                                <span class="bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-semibold"><i class="fa-solid fa-tag text-caseGold mr-1"></i>${item.category}</span>
                                <span class="bg-blue-50 text-caseBlue px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-semibold">${item.delivery}</span>
                                <span class="bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-semibold"><i class="fa-solid fa-clock mr-1"></i>${item.duration}</span>
                            </div>

                            <!-- Banner Image + ALT Text -->
                            ${item.imageUrl ? `
                                <div class="rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-100 relative group">
                                    <img src="${item.imageUrl}" alt="${item.altText || item.caption}" class="w-full h-40 object-cover">
                                    ${item.altText ? `<span class="absolute bottom-2 left-2 bg-black/75 text-white text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100">ALT: ${item.altText}</span>` : ''}
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}

                            <!-- Podcast Link Player -->
                            ${item.podcastUrl ? `
                                <div class="p-2 bg-purple-50 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between border border-purple-100 text-[11px]">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-purple-900">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-play text-purple-600 text-base"></i>
                                        <span>Legal Podcast Note Attached</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <a href="${item.podcastUrl}" target="_blank" class="text-purple-700 underline font-bold">Listen</a>
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <!-- Message / Book / Buy Action Buttons -->
                        <div class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 border-t flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 text-xs">
                            <button onclick="triggerAction('Message', '${item.advocate}')" class="flex-1 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[11px]">
                                <i class="fa-regular fa-comment-dots"></i> Message
                            </button>
                            <button onclick="triggerAction('Book Consultation', '${item.advocate}')" class="flex-1 py-1.5 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-caseBlue border border-blue-200 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[11px]">
                                <i class="fa-regular fa-calendar-check"></i> Book
                            </button>
                            <button onclick="triggerAction('Hire / Buy Service', '${item.advocate}')" class="flex-1 py-1.5 bg-caseBlue hover:bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[11px]">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-bolt text-caseGold"></i> Buy Now
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Threaded Comment / Reviews Section -->
                        <div class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border-t text-[11px]">
                            <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-slate-500 font-medium">
                                <span><i class="fa-solid fa-star text-amber-400"></i> ${item.rating} (${item.reviews.length} Client Reviews)</span>
                                <button onclick="toggleComments(${item.id})" class="text-caseBlue font-bold hover:underline">Thread View</button>
                            </div>

                            <div id="comments-${item.id}" class="hidden space-y-2 pt-2 border-t mt-2">
                                ${item.reviews.map(r => `
                                    <div class="bg-slate-50 p-2 rounded-xl text-[10px]">
                                        <span class="font-bold text-slate-900">${r.author}:</span> ${r.text}
                                    </div>
                                `).join('')}

                                <div class="flex gap-1.5 pt-1">
                                    <input type="text" id="revInput-${item.id}" placeholder="Write a comment or query..." class="flex-1 p-1.5 border rounded-lg text-[10px]">
                                    <button onclick="addComment(${item.id})" class="bg-caseBlue text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold text-[10px]">Post</button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
                grid.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        // Filtering Engine
        function filterListings() {
            const query = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
            const radius = parseFloat(document.getElementById('radiusRange').value);
            const delivery = document.getElementById('deliveryFilter').value;

            let filtered = listings.filter(item => {
                const matchCategory = activeCategory === 'All' || item.category === activeCategory;
                const matchSearch = item.caption.toLowerCase().includes(query) || item.advocate.toLowerCase().includes(query);
                const matchRadius = item.distance <= radius;
                const matchDelivery = delivery === 'All' || item.delivery === delivery;

                return matchCategory && matchSearch && matchRadius && matchDelivery;
            });

            renderListings(filtered);
        }

        // Submit New Tweet-style Listing
        function handlePostSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            let catVal = document.getElementById('postCategory').value;
            if (catVal === 'ADD_CUSTOM') {
                const custom = document.getElementById('customCatInput').value.trim();
                if (custom) {
                    catVal = custom;
                    if (!categories.includes(custom)) {
                        categories.push(custom);
                        initCategoryControls();
                    }
                }
            }

            const newPost = {
                id: Date.now(),
                advocate: "Adv. Rajesh Kumar",
                barId: "D/1842/2012",
                avatar: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560250097-0b93528c311a?auto=format&fit=crop&w=150&q=80",
                verified: true,
                caption: document.getElementById('postCaption').value,
                category: catVal,
                price: parseFloat(document.getElementById('postPrice').value),
                location: "Delhi NCR",
                distance: 2,
                delivery: document.getElementById('postDelivery').value,
                duration: document.getElementById('postDuration').value,
                imageUrl: document.getElementById('postImage').value || "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1450133064473-71024230f91b?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80",
                altText: document.getElementById('postAlt').value || "Service banner image",
                podcastUrl: document.getElementById('postPodcast').value || null,
                rating: 5.0,
                badges: ["Bar Verified"],
                reviews: []
            };

            listings.unshift(newPost);
            toggleModal('tweetModal', false);
            filterListings();
            document.getElementById('postForm').reset();
            alert('Your legal service listing is now published!');
        }

        // Dynamic Helpers
        function selectCategory(cat) {
            activeCategory = cat;
            initCategoryControls();
            filterListings();
        }

        function toggleCustomCategory(val) {
            const box = document.getElementById('customCatBox');
            if (val === 'ADD_CUSTOM') {
                box.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                box.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        }

        function updateRadius(val) {
            document.getElementById('radiusVal').innerText = `${val}km`;
            filterListings();
        }

        function toggleComments(id) {
            const el = document.getElementById(`comments-${id}`);
            el.classList.toggle('hidden');
        }

        function addComment(id) {
            const input = document.getElementById(`revInput-${id}`);
            if (!input.value.trim()) return;

            const item = listings.find(l => l.id === id);
            item.reviews.push({ author: "Verified User", text: input.value });
            filterListings();
            toggleComments(id);
        }

        function triggerAction(type, advocate) {
            document.getElementById('actionModalTitle').innerText = `${type} with ${advocate}`;
            const body = document.getElementById('actionModalBody');

            if (type === 'Message') {
                body.innerHTML = `
                    <label class="block mb-1 font-semibold">Private Encrypted Query:</label>
                    <textarea rows="3" class="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl text-xs" placeholder="Describe your legal matter briefly..."></textarea>
                `;
            } else if (type === 'Book Consultation') {
                body.innerHTML = `
                    <label class="block mb-1 font-semibold">Choose Preferred Appointment Slot:</label>
                    <input type="datetime-local" class="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl text-xs">
                `;
            } else {
                body.innerHTML = `
                    <p>You are proceeding to hire for this service with CaseADVO Escrow Protection. Funds are released only upon successful legal deliverable receipt.</p>
                `;
            }

            toggleModal('actionModal', true);
        }

        function switchTab(tab) {
            document.getElementById('servicesFeedSection').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('podcastsSection').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('reviewsSection').classList.add('hidden');

            document.getElementById('tab-services').className = "pb-3 border-b-2 border-transparent hover:text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2";
            document.getElementById('tab-podcasts').className = "pb-3 border-b-2 border-transparent hover:text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2";
            document.getElementById('tab-reviews').className = "pb-3 border-b-2 border-transparent hover:text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2";

            if (tab === 'services') {
                document.getElementById('servicesFeedSection').classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('tab-services').className = "pb-3 border-b-2 border-caseBlue text-caseBlue flex items-center gap-2 font-bold";
            } else if (tab === 'podcasts') {
                document.getElementById('podcastsSection').classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('tab-podcasts').className = "pb-3 border-b-2 border-caseBlue text-caseBlue flex items-center gap-2 font-bold";
            } else {
                document.getElementById('reviewsSection').classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('tab-reviews').className = "pb-3 border-b-2 border-caseBlue text-caseBlue flex items-center gap-2 font-bold";
            }
        }

        function resetAll() {
            activeCategory = "All";
            document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
            document.getElementById('radiusRange').value = 25;
            document.getElementById('deliveryFilter').value = 'All';
            document.getElementById('radiusVal').innerText = '25km';
            initCategoryControls();
            filterListings();
        }

        function toggleModal(id, show) {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            el.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
            el.classList.toggle('flex', show);
        }

        function saveLocation() {
            const city = document.getElementById('geoCity').value;
            const radius = document.getElementById('geoRadiusInput').value;
            document.getElementById('radiusRange').value = radius;
            document.getElementById('geoLabel').innerText = `${city} (${radius} km)`;
            updateRadius(radius);
            toggleModal('locationModal', false);
        }

        // Initialize App
        initCategoryControls();
        filterListings();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
